sentences.text: Caribospiza is a newly described genus and species of bird.
The genus was named by Viñola-López et al.
The study naming Caribospiza appeared in the Journal of Ornithology in 2026.
Its authors are Lázaro W. Viñola-López, Francisco das Chagas Silva-Neto, Juan N. Almonte-Milán, Beatriz Dybas da Natividade, and Sebastian Bocio.
Caribospiza belongs to the family Accipitridae, the group that includes hawks and eagles.
The genus contains the single species Caribospiza dodi.
Fossils indicate that Caribospiza lived during the Quaternary period.
These remains were recovered from the Dominican Republic.
